_how: Themes for the weekly pep talk. Each run takes the first theme in 'queue' that no edition has used yet (match on 'theme'); when the queue runs out it picks a fresh self-help theme that no edition has covered. Steven adds, removes or reorders themes here. This file is public on the site, so keep private notes out of it.
standards: Original writing only: never quote, paraphrase closely or reuse the structure or step list of any video, book or speech a theme came from, and never name the creator. About 300-400 words, written to be read aloud: second person, short sentences, concrete images, one clear idea. End with one specific action for the coming week. Grounded and kind: no hustle-culture shaming, no promises of guaranteed results, no manifestation or pseudoscience claims, no medical, financial or mental-health advice. Don't repeat a title, opening image or takeaway from any earlier edition.

queue.angle: Stop chasing the dream life; build the identity, environment and small daily systems that make it the default outcome.
Readiness is a feeling that arrives after the first attempt, not before it.
The first hour sets the tone; give it to your priority before the world gets it.
Done and imperfect beats perfect and abandoned; momentum compounds from completion.
Showing up at 40 percent keeps the streak and the identity alive.
The people and inputs around you quietly set your ceiling.

queue.theme: Rest is part of the work

queue.angle: Practise small brave acts until the big ones feel familiar.
